_comment: Handgepflegt (Issue #99): Englischer 'Was ist neu'-Text für GENAU die Version im Feld 'version'. Der CHANGELOG ist nur deutsch und wird nicht maschinell übersetzt (Owner-Entscheidung) - 'title' und 'en' werden beim Release von Hand geschrieben, sinngemäß zum deutschen CHANGELOG-Abschnitt derselben Version. Der Generator (scripts/generate-whatsnew.mjs) übernimmt 'en' NUR, wenn 'version' hier exakt zur aktuellen APP_VERSION passt - sonst bleibt EN absichtlich leer, damit eine vergessene Übersetzung nicht lautlos durchrutscht (siehe web/scripts/check-whatsnew.mjs).
en:
No migration, no change to your data. This update brings the frontend framework and the server libraries to a state without known security flaws. You stay logged in.

• Fixed: your own photos show up again. Since v1.9.2, photos you took of cards and sealed products stayed empty while image optimization was on. They now come straight from the PokéCollect server.
• Security: image optimization is back on, on a framework version without the critical flaws (Next.js 15). The emergency measure from v1.9.3 is lifted: card images are again scaled down by the PokéCollect server, which saves data on your phone. An image address you entered by hand that points to another site stays empty again — the server only loads images from the known card databases and from PokéCollect itself.
• Security: server libraries updated — image processing, web server and login; the known flaws in them are closed. Login now runs on a different library; existing logins stay valid.
• Invalid input is now rejected cleanly instead of causing a server error: absurdly large numbers, invisible control characters and broken characters in text fields. A purchase or value price must not be negative and may have at most two decimal places (as with sealed products already); three decimal places are now rejected instead of silently rounded.
• Maintenance: the frontend runtime is on a supported version, unneeded tools were removed from the server image, and updates always pull fresh base images so operating-system security fixes arrive.
title: Security update, image optimization back on
